description: This file defines the class `MockElectricalMeasurementCluster`, which extends `MockCluster` and simulates electrical measurement cluster behaviors for testing or mocking purposes within a Zigbee or IoT environment. It includes attribute management for active power, multiplier, and divisor, and provides methods to set wattage and generate attribute reports.

classes.name: MockElectricalMeasurementCluster
classes.description: A mock cluster class for electrical measurement, handling attributes related to power and providing methods to simulate attribute reports and calculations.

methods.name: MockElectricalMeasurementCluster
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock electrical measurement cluster with specific attributes.

methods.name: setWatts
methods.description: Sets the active power in watts and updates the corresponding attribute report.

methods.name: getWatts
methods.description: Returns the current active power in watts, calculated based on internal attributes.

methods.name: getMyBytes
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit integer value into a 2-byte array, used for attribute data representation.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Overrides a method to retrieve attribute data based on attribute ID, returning byte arrays for active power, multiplier, and divisor.
